summary: The certified air-gapped appliance (SQLite + in-memory NetworkX) is stable, high-throughput (51.7 emails/sec, p95 517ms), and robust for single-node deployment. However, the scale-out topology (Postgres/Neo4j/Redis/Celery) is largely un-invoked 'diagram-ware', frontend production build has CORS/routing blockers on non-Vite origins, 8 writable API endpoints are completely unauthenticated on network interfaces, and DB migrations/vault backup sync lack operational runbooks.

findings.neo4j: DOES NOT RUN IN LIVE PATH. Only defined in config.py and requirements.txt. backend/app/services/correlation_engine.py executes 100% on in-memory networkx.MultiDiGraph.
findings.redis_celery: BOOTS BUT UNINVOKED IN LIVE PATH. backend/app/services/celery_app.py defines analyze_email_task, but zero FastAPI routes in backend/app/api/v1/ dispatch to Celery. All ingest runs inline synchronous.
findings.postgres: SQLALCHEMY COMPATIBLE BUT UNTESTED IN GOLDEN HARNESS. Base models use standard SQLAlchemy types, but live path defaults strictly to sqlite+aiosqlite.

1.1_scale_out_topology.auditor_errata: SY-1 Errata: The scale-out verdict was determined via comprehensive static code-path analysis (verifying zero Neo4j imports in live graph routes and zero Celery task dispatches from FastAPI endpoints) rather than a physical multi-container docker-compose up.

findings.vite_api_base: frontend/src/services/api.ts defaults API_BASE to empty string if VITE_API_URL is unset at build time. Serving frontend/dist on 127.0.0.1:4000 causes all API requests to hit http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/dashboard/stats resulting in HTTP 404.
findings.cors_policy: backend/app/main.py hardcodes allow_origins strictly to :3000 and :5173. Any standard production origin (e.g. :4000, :80, :443 or reverse proxy hostname) is rejected by CORS.
findings.ui_state: Dashboard renders with 0 counts and empty feed when served from static port 4000 without reverse proxy routing.

findings.receipts: Verified unauthenticated ingestion (POST /raw -> HTTP 201), data exfiltration (GET /emails -> HTTP 200), and metrics inspection (GET /metrics -> HTTP 200) when backend is bound to 0.0.0.0.

1.4_load_concurrency.memory_metric_caveat: Memory metric caveat: The ~4.0 MB sampled memory represents Windows kernel WorkingSetSize delta for the sub-process during testing. The actual resident set size (RSS) of the full Python backend with scikit-learn and NetworkX in-memory graph resides around 45-65 MB.

ranked_gaps.description: Zero Alembic setup. Upgrades requiring DB schema modifications will corrupt or require wiping existing SQLite instances.
EvidenceVault records in SQLite reference disk files in evidence_vault/. Restoring DB without filesystem snapshot (or vice versa) breaks RFC 3227 cryptographic verification.
No log rotation handlers configured in Python backend. Long-running appliance risks disk exhaustion.
No systemd unit, container orchestrator, or external alerting (PagerDuty/Opsgenie) configured in default appliance mode.
